frontend_tools.name: json_render
frontend_tools.description: Show a small structured card in the chat for the user: a title, optional markdown body, optional label/value rows and a tone (info, success, warning, error). Use it for summaries, results or status the user should notice, instead of a long plain message.

body.description: Markdown text shown under the title.

items.description: Label/value rows, shown as a list under the body.

label.description: Row label, e.g. a field name.

tone.description: Accent of the card. Default info.
